rules: A row is functional only when a functional-class command exits 0 and its declared assertion passes; otherwise it takes the highest class that really passed, and declared versus observed is shown.
Readiness means version, sign-in, import, listing or a health endpoint. Exit 0 alone is not a functional E2E.
Live counts are asserted with >= and the observed value is recorded; equality is reserved for deterministic results.
Scanners also run against a known-bad fixture, because zero findings alone proves nothing.
No probe writes into a repository, starts or stops a service, prints a credential, or makes a provider model call; exactly one probe spends an account credit (Tavily).
Displayed output is a bounded, redacted excerpt with the hash of the displayed text; the complete original is retained privately with its own recovery hash.
Every screenshot is opened and described by the coordinator; the review is bound to the image by sha256, and an unreviewed or changed image is not evidence.
Lifetime figures are each tool's own non-additive estimate. They are never summed and are never provider savings; losses are shown as losses.
Verdicts are selection verdicts for this profile with their evidence chain. The page makes no universal claim about any repository.
A local integration check (a test or script that does not invoke the component) is labelled as such and never counts toward the row's class.
